Subject: Renewal quote and billing cadence for Acme - Redwood

Hey Ben / Naomi,

We're reviewing the renewal for Acme (end of year) and want to lock the commercial terms this week so procurement can route the PO. A few quick asks from finance:
- Can you confirm the net-new committed spend for 2027 (seat + overage cap)?
- Preferred billing cadence: monthly vs quarterly vs annual invoice?
- Any available goodwill credits tied to usage over the past 6 months — our CFO asked.

I've attached the PO template and our current view of usage. If we can get a final SOW + billing cadence by Mon 23rd, we can route internally for signatures.

Thanks,
James

James — quick clarifying notes from FinOps: 
- Billing cadence: Acme historically pays monthly but prefers quarterly invoices for headcount alignment. We can support quarterly invoicing net-30 if legal signs off.
- Credits: eligible for a one-time 5% retention credit applied to the first invoice after renewal, not retroactive.
- Final SOW needs explicit "overage cap" language and the PO number mapping for reconciliation.

Ben — can you add the PO mapping field in v2 and flag the overage cap language for legal? Also request that Acme confirms the billing contact (name + email).

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
[NOTE: Accepted delivery terms are Net-30; see internal FinOps policy 2026-Q4]

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal quote and billing cadence for Acme - Redwood

Looping in product/CS context — Acme has shown a minor contraction signal (usage down ~12% q/q for ML embeddings). My recommendation to reduce churn-risk is:
- Add a 60-day pilot extension for their top 2 projects at no extra charge (tied to the renewal commitment).
- Include an agreed set of success metrics (3 prompts / day baseline) and a monthly adoption check-in for the first quarter.

If Finance is comfortable with a one-time retention credit (Naomi suggested 5%), we can present the package as: 
- Commitment: 12 months, tiered token commitment (Ben's SOW v2)
- Goodwill: 5% retention credit on first invoice + 60-day pilot extension
- Ops: Marissa to run adoption enablement and weekly playbook check-ins for 30 days post-renewal.

James — will this packaging be acceptable to procurement? If so we'll finalize and submit DocuSign.

Onward,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
[attachment: ACME_Renewal_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf, 132KB)]
